data.title: Internal Candidacy and Public Competition Governance (5 U.S.C. § 2301 & UK Civil Service Management Code)
data.summary: 5 U.S.C. § 2301 states merit-system principles for the US federal civil service, including recruitment from appropriate sources and selection after fair and open competition. UK Civil Service recruitment rules likewise govern appointment on merit after fair and open competition, subject to defined exceptions. These are public-service rules; they do not create a general private-sector duty to disclose an internal candidate or prove that an external process is deceptive.
data.citation: 5 U.S.C. § 2301(b)(1) ('Recruitment should be from qualified individuals from appropriate sources in an endeavor to achieve a work force from all segments of society, and selection and advancement should be determined solely on the basis of relative ability, knowledge, and skills, after fair and open competition which assures that all receive equal opportunity.').
